instruction: A candid family photograph shows a medium full shot of an indoor playroom. On a green rug with a white faux fur mat, the man with grey hair and beard (R1) is on all fours, wearing a blue and white checkered shirt and dark jeans, smiling at the camera. Sitting on his back, the older girl with long blonde hair (R2), wearing a pink short-sleeved dress and grey tights, extends her arms out like wings with a joyful smile. In the background, a younger blonde girl in a white top smiles with her arms slightly raised. A wooden clothing rack with hanging dresses stands behind them. The scene is illuminated by soft, bright indoor light, creating a warm, pastel-toned atmosphere.
